timing_method_selection_matrix.physical_clock: Recoil stopping power dE/dx (electronic + nuclear slowing in solid material)
timing_method_selection_matrix.primary_observable: Doppler-broadened line shape or angle-dependent centroid shift F(tau)
timing_method_selection_matrix.primary_nuisance_response: Stopping power model miscalibration (5-15%), side-feeding cascades, contaminant lines
timing_method_selection_matrix.counter_evidence_or_diagnostic: Scale Invariance Theorem: global stopping scale cancels identically in intra-band and inter-band B(E2) ratios

timing_method_selection_matrix.time_window_nominal: 1 ps - 1 ns (down to ~0.5 ps with DDCM)
timing_method_selection_matrix.physical_clock: Recoil flight velocity in vacuum v0 and micrometer flight distance d = v0 * t
timing_method_selection_matrix.primary_observable: Shifted (flight) and unshifted (stopped) gamma-ray peak intensities I_s(d), I_u(d)
timing_method_selection_matrix.primary_nuisance_response: Distance zero-point calibration, target-stopper foil parallelism, vacuum deorientation G_k(t)
timing_method_selection_matrix.counter_evidence_or_diagnostic: Component-conditioned deorientation: G_SH(t) != G_US(t); DDCM eliminates absolute distance zero dependency

timing_method_selection_matrix.method: Fast Timing (Electronic Delayed Coincidence / MSCD / LaBr3)
timing_method_selection_matrix.physical_clock: High-speed electronic TAC / digital CFD timestamping
timing_method_selection_matrix.primary_observable: Time distribution between cascade feeding gamma1 and decay gamma2 in fast scintillators
timing_method_selection_matrix.primary_nuisance_response: Detector prompt response function (PRF) shape, energy-dependent time walk, PMT drift
timing_method_selection_matrix.counter_evidence_or_diagnostic: Mirror Symmetric Centroid Difference (MSCD): Delta C = 2*tau + PRD(E1,E2), cancels detector walk with zero crossing at Delta E = 0

timing_method_selection_matrix.physical_clock: Larmor precession frequency omega_L = g*mu_N*B/hbar or quadrupole frequency omega_0 = 3*e*Q*Vzz/[2I(2I-1)hbar]
timing_method_selection_matrix.primary_observable: Time-differential perturbation ratio R(t) = (N(+theta,t) - N(-theta,t))/(N(+theta,t) + N(-theta,t)) modulating decay
timing_method_selection_matrix.primary_nuisance_response: Paramagnetic relaxation / spin deorientation lambda_k, incomplete alignment, host lattice defects
timing_method_selection_matrix.counter_evidence_or_diagnostic: Precession measurement across multiple angles/fields; simultaneous g and Q extraction in non-cubic hosts

boundary_conclusion: The four nuclear lifetime and moment measurement methods (DSAM, RDDS, Fast Timing MSCD, TDPAD)
span twelve orders of magnitude in time (from ~10 fs to ~10 us).
Each method relies on a distinct physical clock (matter stopping, vacuum flight, electronics, or Larmor precession)
and possesses specific dominant nuisance responses that must be diagnosed with tailored counter-evidence.
This matrix provides a source-grounded decision tree for experimental method selection
without awarding Day 19 curriculum credit prematurely.
